run_ui_md_lines_for_lead: Timeline trims (lane SMB-TIMELINE-TRIM-1): toolbar Selection / Ripple / Roll / Slip / Slide sets what edge and body drags do (ripple: later content on sync-locked tracks shifts; roll: the edit between two abutting clips; slip: source window; slide: between neighbours); one undo step per drag.

Click a clip edge to select that edit point; Trim Session opens the outgoing/incoming tiles with -step/-1/+1/+step, In / Out / In+Out focus, ripple/roll toggle, Composite Preview, Apply (one undo step) and Cancel (nothing committed).

Keys with the panel active and a clip selected: Ctrl+Alt+Left/Right slip one frame (Shift: multi-frame step), Alt+, / Alt+. slide one frame (Shift: step), Alt+Left/Right nudge the clip; Extend Edit rolls the selected (else nearest) edit to the playhead.

A trim past a limit commits the achieved part (state_json timeline.last_trim); a refusal names its code in the status log and changes nothing. Unknown source lengths refuse source extensions (source_extent_unknown).
